veranderings.voor: oor baie jare in verskillende lande
veranderings.na: oor baie jare heen in verskillende lande
veranderings.rede: The idiomatic Afrikaans for a span of time is 'oor baie jare heen'.
The subject is 'baie mense', so a singular 'die wond' reads as one shared wound; each died of their own wound.

veranderings.na: sonder dat iemand hoef te sny
veranderings.rede: With 'X-strale' as subject, 'sonder om te sny' says the X-rays do not cut; naming the implied person removes the dangling infinitive.

veranderings.blok: Dit is nie die hele lys nie
veranderings.rede: The body 'verwerp' a transplanted organ (orgaanverwerping); 'afwys' means turning down a request or person.
